neighbours.label: bare ' V' piece that opens an acronym or split word (" V|FR", " V|TA", "non|-v|olatile"); other initial letters weaker
fire: The station transmits on VLF so that submarines can receive it.
The radio room switched to VHF once the ship neared the coast.
Each morning she takes the VRE train into the capital.
The cardiologist found a small VSD during the scan.
The aircraft tracked the VOR beacon north of the airfield.
After the operation he was given drugs to prevent VTE.
The blood test showed raised VLDL and low vitamin D.
He graduated from VCU with a degree in sculpture.
quiet: The station transmits on ELF so that submarines can receive it.
The radio room switched to UHF once the ship neared the coast.
Each morning she takes the MBTA train into the capital.
The cardiologist found a small ASD during the scan.
The aircraft tracked the NDB beacon north of the airfield.
After the operation he was given drugs to prevent DVT.
The blood test showed raised HDL and low vitamin D.
He graduated from UCLA with a degree in sculpture.

notes: Card: ' V' / ' v' / ' В' / 'V'. Probes: V|FR 0.69, V|TA 0.43, -v|olatile 0.60, V-shaped 0.27, ' VOC' 0.10, ' Vulner' 0.27; I|FR 0.30, so near misses with other-letter acronyms may leak. Tokenizer splits checked for the fire words.
